purpose: Validate actual FMVMM soft EM numerical repairs and compare selection policies; prior analytic whole-mixture backend is excluded.
development_rule: V3 uses validated MSNC analytic and skew-t semi-analytic component scores in the same native outer EM. Domain, initializations, screen cutoff and stopping tolerances are unchanged from V2. Preserve all prior development outputs; no source edits during scientific runs. Native density stress repairs are recorded by package commit and source hashes. All mixture candidates receive the same 1200-iteration maximum (increased from400 after one V2 baseline candidate remained slow); the stopping tolerances are unchanged. Unresolved selected weighted profiles stop the comparison and remain recorded instead of supporting family exclusions.
validation_rule: Use reserved cases only after selecting/fixing a method and policy; do not tune to validation; direct fresh pipelines versusfast_student and reference_student.
success_rule: No invalid densities or silent failures. Selected and reference fits need explicit local convergence diagnostics. Screening should retain comparable BIC/predictive quality while saving distinct models and meaningful direct runtime relative to fast_student. A speedup solely against all assignments is insufficient.

method_notes.student_bootstrap: Gaussian pilot plus only K t weighted profiles and one t mixture; then K*L Student profiles. All required dependencies charged.
method_notes.student_local: Finite fixed-Student-table ordered one-family moves; no iterative q update.
method_notes.profile: Same package constrained weighted component objective/domain as in EM; finite multistart local profiles, notcertifiedglobal.
method_notes.timing: Shared operation accounting for development; independent direct timing for selected validation includes data preparation, all fitting/profile work and a checkpoint with fitted parameters and compact diagnostics. Test metrics and duplicate aggregate analysis records are outside method timing.
method_notes.constraints: Training-only whitening; bounds and floors disclosed, canonical GH parameterization and positive VG center shape gap required. These restrict the statistical target.
method_notes.provenance: Record data generator, initialization helper, full FMVMM package, runner, protocol, versions, task/settings/methods and timing mode. Only complete records with matching experiment identity can be reused; incomplete records require an explicit new output directory.

validation_release.L5: Three previously reserved cases released on 2026-09-16 before their first fit. Method and numerical settings fixed from development.
validation_release.L13: Still locked pending GH/VG profile investigation.

validation_method: student_ranked_screen; one Student score table, shared2logn allowance, one score-ranked assignment per retained canonical model; no neighbourhood updates
validation_gate: All attempted full fits and selected profiles must meet diagnostics; report every failure. Primary target is attained BIC agreement within1e-4, secondary report regret within2BIC and test-log-density loss within.01perobservation. Direct total runtime againstfast_student includes all fits/profiles, initialization and fitted-output checkpoint. These three cases are a feasibility check, not a population success-rate estimate. Do not retune after validation.
